svg.title: Design Patterns - Factory Method & Abstract Factory

g.text: Design Patterns - Factory Method & Abstract Factory
: let the DI container create every agent and hand
the whole roster to clients as one abstraction (IAgent[]).
- Creator: agentsProvider() → { provide: AGENTS, useFactory, inject: AGENT_CLASSES }
: Provide an interface for creating families
of related or dependent objects without specifying
// Registry usage (agents created by Nest DI via agentsProvider())
// Adding a role: new profile + 2 strategies + 1 entry in AGENT_CLASSES
- Easy to add new agent types
the only list of concrete agent classes.
depend on IAgent, so a 9th role does not
Registry / factory provider benefits in AI-CORP
: the orchestrator does not know concrete agent classes
: add a role without modifying the orchestrator
: per-role defaults in one RoleProfile (also used by the seed)
: the token can be built with fake agents (TestAgent)
: all agents get their dependencies from the container
: Route to cheapest provider with same capabilities
